# ResinArt — Complete Editorial & Architectural Specification Map

## About ResinArt
ResinArt (https://resin_art.vercel.app/) is an informational, educational, and editorial web publication centered on the craft, science, safety, and creative execution of epoxy and polyurethane resin art. It serves beginners, studio hobbyists, and professional makers with peer-vetted knowledge on mixing ratios, chemical curing, exothermic mitigation, bubble degasification, color pigment dispersion, and studio safety.

## Complete Route Directory

### 1. Foundation & Fundamentals
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/ : Homepage featuring curated guides, technique showcase, project ideas, safety essentials, and troubleshooting.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-for-beginners/ : Complete beginner syllabus, workspace preparation, resin chemistry basics, first pours, and mistake prevention.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/epoxy-resin/ : Chemical breakdown of Bisphenol-A resin and polyamine hardeners, shore hardness, and UV stability.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-vs-epoxy/ : Technical clarification between polyester casting resin, polyurethane resin, UV resin, and two-part epoxy.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-mixing/ : Gravimetric vs volumetric measuring, meniscus reading, 3-minute scrape-and-fold protocols, and thermal runaway prevention.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-curing/ : Curing stages (gel stage, green cure, full cure), ambient humidity thresholds, and post-cure polishing.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/remove-resin-bubbles/ : Torch sweeping, heat guns, 91%+ isopropyl alcohol misting, vacuum degassing chambers, and pressure pots.

### 2. Techniques & Applied Craft
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-techniques/ : Primary index of resin pouring styles.
  - Ocean Resin Art: Cellular lacing, white wave paste formulation, and directional heat gun airflow.
  - Geode Resin Art: Natural crystal embedding, crushed glass, gold leaf gilding, and multidimensional shading.
  - Dirty Pour: Multi-pigment cup layering and controlled surface tipping.
  - Swipe Technique: Cell generator additives and damp paper towel drags.
  - Layering: Depth illusion, 3D floating botanical elements, and layer adhesion sanding.
  - Marbling: High-viscosity resin veins and soft alcohol blending.
  - Petri Dish Style: Alcohol ink drop dispersion and heavy white sinker ink reaction.

### 3. Projects & Step-by-Step Builds
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-projects/ : Full step-by-step master guides with materials, tools, difficulty, and curing timelines.
  - Resin Coasters: Heat-resistant casting, silicone mold maintenance, and cork backing.
  - Resin Trays: Wood board sealing, handles mounting, and clear flood coat leveling.
  - Resin Jewelry: Open-back bezels, UV resin flash curing, and hypoallergenic hardware.
  - Resin Wall Art: MDF cradle boards, edge taping, and resin flow manipulation.
  - Resin Bookmarks: Flexible curing resins and tassel attachments.
  - Resin Tables: Live-edge slab stabilization, barrier dams, and deep-pour epoxy layers.

### 4. Supplies & Tools Taxonomy
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-supplies/ : Non-commercial overview of epoxy grades, silicone molds, mica powders, alcohol inks, liquid dyes, glitter, and inclusions.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-tools/ : Digital scales, silicone mixing beakers, silicone stirrers, butane culinary torches, heat guns, level gauges, and silicone work mats.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-molds/ : Platinum-cure vs condensation-cure silicone, mold release conditioning, and demolding techniques.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-pigments/ : Powder vs liquid pigments, moisture content risks, tint saturation maximums (≤ 6% rule), and lightfastness.

### 5. Studio Health, Safety & Troubleshooting
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-safety/ : Organic vapor half-face respirators (NIOSH OV/P95), nitrile gloves (latex permeability warnings), room air exchanges (ACH), eye protection, and dermal decontamination.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-troubleshooting/ : Interactive diagnosis for sticky uncured resin, amine blush, fish eyes, thermal cracking, bubbles, cloudiness, and yellowing.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-care/ : Long-term preservation, gentle soap cleansing, microfiber polishing, scratch buffing, and UV shielding.
- https://resin_art.vercel.app/resin-art-faq/ : Indexed answers across beginner, chemical, tool, and artistic categories.
